data.headline: Focus
data.text: Control Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, Without specialisation

data.headline: Target group
data.text: Bachelor graduates of a degree programme of seven or at least six semesters at a university in the fields of general electrical engineering, communications engineering and computer networks, electrical engineering and information technology, computer engineering and other suitable courses in electrical, information and communication technology.

data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
The Master's degree is internationally oriented \; it is offered for both German and foreign students. Classes are generally taught in English in order to prepare students for an academic activity in a world of work characterised by internationality and globalisation. This is aided further by corresponding modules in which students work together in international project teams.
Skills beyond the subject are to be expanded.
